build.beforeDevCommand: npm run prepare:notices && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && npm run prepare:notices

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-src 'none'
